title: Métriques métier — Supermarket Demo
description: Parcours golden signals : Métier (commandes, réassort, stock) → Traffic → Latency → Errors → Saturation. Les métriques techniques des microservices sont représentées par des courbes temporelles, avec une série et une légende par microservice lorsque la dimension est disponible.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business.orders.completed IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business.orders.completed) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY instance = resource.attributes.service.instance.id, channel = attributes.channel | EVAL channel_total = end - start | STATS total_orders = SUM(channel_total)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business.stock.restock.requested IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business.stock.restock.requested) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY instance = resource.attributes.service.instance.id | EVAL total_requested = end - start | STATS total_requested = SUM(total_requested)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business.stock.restock.completed IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business.stock.restock.completed) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY instance = resource.attributes.service.instance.id | EVAL total_completed = end - start | STATS total_completed = SUM(total_completed)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL requested_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business.stock.restock.requested), completed_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business.stock.restock.completed) | STATS requested_start = MIN(requested_counter), requested_end = MAX(requested_counter), completed_start = MIN(completed_counter), completed_end = MAX(completed_counter) BY instance = resource.attributes.service.instance.id | EVAL restock_gap = (requested_end - requested_start) - (completed_end - completed_start) | STATS restock_gap = SUM(restock_gap)

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business.orders.completed IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business.orders.completed) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), channel = attributes.channel | EVAL channel_total = end - start | STATS total_orders = SUM(channel_total) BY bucket

config.title: Métier — flux de réassort par période

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL requested_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business.stock.restock.requested), completed_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business.stock.restock.completed) | STATS requested_start = MIN(requested_counter), requested_end = MAX(requested_counter), completed_start = MIN(completed_counter), completed_end = MAX(completed_counter) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL requested = requested_end - requested_start, completed = completed_end - completed_start

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND attributes.channel == "rest" AND metrics.business.orders.completed IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business.orders.completed) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL total_rest = end - start

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND attributes.channel == "kafka" AND metrics.business.orders.completed IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business.orders.completed) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL total_kafka = end - start

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http.server.requests.active IS NOT NULL | STATS active_requests = AVG(metrics.http.server.requests.active)

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.process.cpu.usage IS NOT NULL | STATS cpu_average = AVG(metrics.process.cpu.usage) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name, bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

config.title: Saturation — mémoire JVM dans le temps

data_source.query: FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.jvm.memory.used IS NOT NULL AND metrics.jvm.memory.max > 0 | EVAL memory_ratio = metrics.jvm.memory.used / metrics.jvm.memory.max | STATS memory_ratio = AVG(memory_ratio) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name, bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business.stock.quantity IS NOT NULL | EVAL stock = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business.stock.quantity) | STATS stock = MAX(stock) BY product_id = attributes.product_id, product_name = attributes.product_name | SORT stock ASC

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http.server.requests.active IS NOT NULL | STATS samples = COUNT(*), avg_active = AVG(metrics.http.server.requests.active), max_active = MAX(metrics.http.server.requests.active) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name, method = attributes.method, endpoint = attributes.uri | SORT max_active DESC
FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http.server.requests.active IS NOT NULL | STATS samples = COUNT(*)

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http.server.requests.active IS NOT NULL | STATS average_active = AVG(metrics.http.server.requests.active)

FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http.server.requests.active IS NOT NULL | EVAL error = CASE(attributes.outcome != "SUCCESS", 1, 0) | STATS total = COUNT(*), total_errors = SUM(error) | EVAL error_rate = 100 * total_errors / total

config.title: Saturation — surcharge GC JVM dans le temps

data_source.query: FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.jvm.gc.overhead IS NOT NULL | EVAL overhead = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm.gc.overhead) | STATS gc_overhead = AVG(overhead) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name, bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

data_source.query: FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND (metrics.kafka.consumer.fetch.manager.fetch.latency.avg IS NOT NULL OR metrics.kafka.producer.request.latency.avg IS NOT NULL) | STATS fetch_avg_ms = AVG(metrics.kafka.consumer.fetch.manager.fetch.latency.avg), fetch_max_ms = MAX(metrics.kafka.consumer.fetch.manager.fetch.latency.max), producer_request_avg_ms = AVG(metrics.kafka.producer.request.latency.avg), producer_request_max_ms = MAX(metrics.kafka.producer.request.latency.max), records_consumed_rate = AVG(metrics.kafka.consumer.fetch.manager.records.consumed.rate), lag_max = MAX(metrics.kafka.consumer.fetch.manager.records.lag.max) BY topic = attributes.topic, partition = attributes.partition | SORT fetch_max_ms DESC

config.title: Kafka — latence de lecture des messages

data_source.query: FROM metrics-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.kafka.consumer.fetch.manager.fetch.latency.max IS NOT NULL | STATS p50_ms = PERCENTILE(metrics.kafka.consumer.fetch.manager.fetch.latency.max, 50), p95_ms = PERCENTILE(metrics.kafka.consumer.fetch.manager.fetch.latency.max, 95), p99_ms = PERCENTILE(metrics.kafka.consumer.fetch.manager.fetch.latency.max, 99), max_ms = MAX(metrics.kafka.consumer.fetch.manager.fetch.latency.max), measurements = COUNT(*) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name, topic = attributes.topic | SORT p99_ms DESC
